summary: Corvex, Inc. filed an 8-K with Items 2.02, 8.01, and 9.01, disclosing unaudited pro forma condensed combined financial statements for the merger completed on March 19, 2026, with Corvex Legacy Holdings, Inc. The filing is a routine post-merger financial statement update under Item 2.02/8.01, not a special-situation event. No deal terms, prices, or recommendations are provided. The merger itself occurred in March 2026 and is disclosed retroactively. This 8-K is merely a financial reporting requirement, so it does not qualify as a special situation. What to watch: no new event; subsequent filings may detail integration results.
